strings.name: José Mourinho
strings.role: Football coach · Champion in several national leagues
strings.summary: Mourinho progressed through playing, interpreting and assistant roles to elite coaching. He won the Champions League with Porto and Inter and league titles in Portugal, England, Italy and Spain. His preparation, transitions and results-focused methods brought influence, while public remarks and confrontational management drew criticism. After Roma, Fenerbahçe and Benfica, he returned to Real Madrid in 2026.
